script_text: Pisces, as a water sign ruled by Neptune, this week the money floor drops, then Neptune helps you rebuild it. Monday through Wednesday, Venus in your 4th House squares the Saturn-Neptune conjunction in your 2nd House, so a rent issue can strain the budget; your instinct to rescue gets tested. Monday is roughest because Venus brushes Uranus in Gemini, sparking a home or family upset. Tuesday improves as Mercury in Cancer trines Neptune and Saturn, making a money conversation possible. Wednesday is your power day because Saturn stations retrograde in Aries, locking the 2nd House lesson. My advice: stop funding another's chaos. Thursday through Sunday, the Sun sextiles Mars in your 10th House, then enters Cancer and your 5th House, so career visibility, romance, and income brighten. Sunday is best for love: Jupiter in the 5th supports a flirtation or proposal. Follow for daily updates.
